🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; sector weakness. Confirmation comes from zero positive sectors and both Financials (-7.55% 1W) and Industrials (-7.21% 1W) being negative; leadership is Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), but only on a relative basis. Style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication, Consumer Staples, and Utilities were the least weak sectors, though all were negative over the week. Communication includes T (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.89%), RECOVERY; Consumer Staples includes TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND; Utilities includes DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%), ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology was weakest, down 13.10% for the week, with NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND. Materials and Energy also lagged: FCX (1W: -22.37% | 1M: -28.80%), BELOW TREND, and XOM (1W: -5.62% | 1M: -9.67%), BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five: PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%), RECOVERY; TJX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -4.93%), RECOVERY; TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND; KHC (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +1.20%), ABOVE TREND; T (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.89%), RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), although overall sector breadth remains weak.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND; FCX (1W: -22.37% | 1M: -28.80%), BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -20.85% | 1M: -23.80%), BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -20.54% | 1M: -16.45%), BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -19.27% | 1M: -19.40%), BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best weekly momentum: PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%), RECOVERY; TJX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -4.93%), RECOVERY; and TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND. The first two are short-term rebounds against negative monthly performance; watch for trend confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weakest, down 13.10% for the week and 18.76% for the month; stock-level positive breadth was not provided. NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -7.33% | 1M: -6.84%), BELOW TREND; and GOOGL (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -18.18%), BELOW TREND, confirm broad pressure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials fell 7.55% for the week and 5.60% for the month; stock-level positive breadth was not provided. JPM (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -7.73%), BELOW TREND; V (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -2.83%), BELOW TREND; and MA (1W: -5.38% | 1M: -1.20%), BELOW TREND, show weakness across key names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare declined 6.11% for the week and 3.79% for the month; stock-level positive breadth was not provided. SYK (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +0.95%), ABOVE TREND, contrasts with UNH (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%), BELOW TREND; JNJ (1W: -5.35% | 1M: +1.07%), CORRECTION, is pulling back against a positive month.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Positioning?
Favor relative resilience over high-beta exposure, while keeping risk measured given RISK-OFF conditions and 0/11 positive sectors. Monitor strength in TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND, and DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%), ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to deeply weak technology names such as NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor follow-through in PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%), RECOVERY, and TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND, if weekly strength persists. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND, and INTU (1W: -20.85% | 1M: -23.80%), BELOW TREND, remain at risk if selling continues.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Watch Consumer Staples, the least weak sector over the month, for stabilization; TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND, is a relative-strength name. BEARISH: Technology remains weakest at -13.10% for the week, with 0/11 sectors positive overall; Materials also lagged, with FCX (1W: -22.37% | 1M: -28.80%), BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so use performance-based triggers: watch whether NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND, stabilizes after its steep drawdown, and whether PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%), RECOVERY, sustains its rebound. A continued decline in JPM (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -7.73%), BELOW TREND, would reinforce broad financial weakness; a sustained hold in TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND, would confirm relative resilience.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PANW (+45): analyst target increase; PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%), RECOVERY, shows weekly confirmation but remains negative over the month. UNH (+55): named a 2027 best idea and upgraded; UNH (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%), BELOW TREND, diverges sharply from the positive catalyst. XOM (+55): government approval for its revised LNG plan; XOM (1W: -5.62% | 1M: -9.67%), BELOW TREND, has yet to confirm the news.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-85): reported SEC accounting probe; NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND, confirms the negative catalyst. INTU (-70): revenue guidance cut; INTU (1W: -20.85% | 1M: -23.80%), BELOW TREND, confirms the news. AMAT (-45): price-target reduction; AMAT (1W: -18.20% | 1M: -19.30%), BELOW TREND, also confirms weakness.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with mixed / no clear style leadership; breadth is 0/11 sectors positive, with sector weakness and Financials and Industrials both negative. Relative strength remains in TGT (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), ABOVE TREND, and DUK (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%), ABOVE TREND. Monitor the gap between positive PANW news and its negative monthly return, and the continued downside confirmation in NVDA (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), BELOW TREND.
